title: Azusawa Kohane — For A New Dawn〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's see... I've got my indoor shoes, my pencil case, my student ID and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I still don't really feel like one.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I also sort of forgot about school because of how we've started practicing with An's dad.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That reminds me.
I should go over those things we talked about during practice today and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Hey, it's me!
Is this Kohane I'm speaking to?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<I felt like talking.
Are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Yeah. I was just getting my things together for tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Great! Actually, I should get home soon and start getting all my school stuff together too.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <I was practicing by myself a bit at Weekend Garage. I'm heading home right after I clean up here.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
I still need to take a bath and have dinner, but I'm totally ready to fall asleep.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <I actually fell asleep for a second in the tub.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Haha. See what I mean?
Still, we need to be careful so we don't catch a cold or anything.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Come to think of it, tomorrow might be kinda rough. The teachers are gonna get so mad if we fall asleep during the opening ceremony.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <It is supposed to officially mark the start of the new school year.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <But I still don't feel like a second-year...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <It's been practice, practice, practice every day lately! I haven't really had time to think about anything else.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <That being said, I'm super excited about my new class! I can't wait to see who's in it!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
<Me too!
Is there anyone you want to be your classmate?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Well...
It'd be great to be classmates with Mizuki again since we get along so well.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Who else...? Hmm...
You know what? Anyone's welcome in my book!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <It's just like you to say that.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<What about you, Kohane?
Is there anyone you wanna be classmates with?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
<Me...? Maybe Shiho?
We got to know each other well last year, and we can talk about music. I'd really like to be classmates with her again.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Honami, Emu and Saki would also be nice since we were in the same group when we went to the Seaside School.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <The Seaside School...? Oh, right. Your classes got all mixed up that time.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Yeah. That's why it'd be nice to talk again as classmates.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <You have been singing and practicing together a lot.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <But we haven't really talked about much other than that...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <So, if we were to become classmates, we might get a chance to talk about stuff other than music.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Yeah, you'd definitely get more of those opportunities if you became her classmate.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <You could ask to borrow her pens, have her show you her notes, see if she can give you a better explanation of what happened in class and stuff!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <No, wait. You're the one explaining stuff to others most of the time, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <But you're right about getting more opportunities to talk if we do become classmates, An.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Still, what is my new class going to look like?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<I really wanna know too.
I'd probably end up lying awake thinking about that if I weren't so exhausted.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<I'm glad we could talk, Kohane.
Thanks for agreeing to chat so suddenly.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <No, I'm also really glad that we could talk.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Anyway, let's both rest up so we don't fall asleep at our opening ceremonies tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was going to practice a little...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(But I am feeling pretty tired.
I should probably go to bed instead.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I get to see everyone at school tomorrow.)
